projection: orthographic X/Y; plot_x=0.9*standard_1020_x_m/r_max; plot_y=0.9*standard_1020_y_m/r_max; r_max=max over declared 22 sensors sqrt(X^2+Y^2)
interpolation: linear Delaunay triangulation within the sensor convex hull only; values outside convex hull stay white
out_of_range_values: clip only display to fixed range; count and report sensor and grid values outside [-6,+6]; retain original numbers
scalp_map_aggregation: trial dB within class and session -> equal-session participant mean -> equal-participant cohort mean; no target BA binning
sensor_marker_style: all 22 black open sensor points; C3/Cz/C4 labeled
physiology_units: 10*log10(task integrated band power / baseline integrated band power), dB; no absolute physical-voltage calibration claimed
not_a_source_localization: template sensor positions and orthographic interpolation only; no participant-specific registration or cortical inference

inline_TeX_display_grid.purpose: display-only reduction of patches for a self-contained TeX document; scientific summaries and PNG/PDF/SVG use the unchanged values and 161x161 display grid
